title: Monsters of God
description:
S01 E05 — Head of the Snake
Malaysian kingpin Anson Wong emerges as a shadowy force at the center of the global reptile trade; a U.S. agent goes under cover to penetrate Wong's inner circle.

title: Conan O'Brien Must Go
description:
S03 E03 — Morocco
Conan forces his follower Yassir to watch the movie synonymous with his hometown, "Casablanca," and promises to get Sona, his podcast co-host, her beloved Moroccan argan oil.

title: Hard Knocks: Training Camp With the Seattle Seahawks
description:
S21 E05
Following head coach Mike Macdonald, quarterback Sam Darnold and the rest of the Super Bowl-winning Seattle Seahawks in training camp in Renton, Wash.

title: Alex vs. A-Rod
description:
S01 E01 — Part I
Alex becomes a huge superstar and soon transforms into one of baseball's history most controversial figures.

title: Alex vs. A-Rod
description:
S01 E02 — Part II
Told by Alex Rodriguez, this three-part documentary explores the demon he called A-Rod and the work he's done to become Alex once more.

title: Alex vs. A-Rod
description:
S01 E03 — Part III
In 2013, a newspaper exposé once again links Alex Rodriguez to performance-enhancing drugs, triggering Major League Baseball's longest-ever PED suspension and a storm of public hostility.

title: The Rehearsal
description:
S02 E05 — Washington
Nathan heads to Washington.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries
description:
S01 E01 — Murder in G Major
A new teacher at an Irish prep school is shocked to find a ghost in her house. She decides to help solve his murder in the hopes that it will allow him to move on.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries
description:
S01 E02 — Buried at C
Gethsemane and Eamon investigate the death of a sea captain; Tamera Mowry-Housley, Risteard Cooper and Marco Grazzini star.

title: Crossword Mysteries: A Puzzle to Die For
description: A crossword puzzle editor finds herself dragged into a police investigation after several of her clues are linked to unsolved crimes.

title: Crossword Mysteries
description:
S01 E02 — Proposing Murder
Tess dives into Logan's murder investigation of her friend who was about to propose with her help; as she grows closer to the truth, she fears it could ruin everyone's happily ever after.

title: Trees, and Other Entanglements
description: People and the natural world intertwine in the stories of a young boy hidden among trees, an artist refining American bonsai, a photographer observing trees, a mother fighting to protect the forests and a man who steadfastly plants them.

title: What's My Name: Muhammad Ali
description:
S01 E01 — Part I
The early boxing career of Cassius Clay includes a gold medal win at the 1960 Olympics in Rome; after converting to Islam, Clay changes his name to Muhammad Ali; Ali is stripped of his heavyweight title for refusing induction into the military.

title: What's My Name: Muhammad Ali
description:
S01 E02 — Part II
Ali becomes the first three-time heavyweight champion of the world, but the toll of so many historic ring encounters starts to show; "The Greatest" travels the globe as a goodwill ambassador, philanthropist and activist.

title: Fast Friends
description:
S01 E01 — The One With the Weenie From Linguine
In celebration of "Friends" 30th anniversary, Whitney Cummings kicks off the competition by welcoming hairstylists Suzanne and Michelle, siblings Shelby and Lewis and childhood pals Michael and Kevin, whose fandom knowledge is put to the test.

title: Fast Friends
description:
S01 E02 — The One With the Chest Wax
Mother and daughter Yolanda and Ariana, couple Halani and Riordan and brothers Sam and Matt face off in all-new challenges; a guest tests "Friends" party knowledge; the teams recall details from classic scenes and play a game of charades.

title: Fast Friends
description:
S01 E03 — The One Where Boston Is a State
Whitney welcomes three new teams of "Friends" aficionados to the competition; the contestants must dig deep into their knowledge of Phoebe's songs, the show's arguments and locations where the gang travelled.

title: Fast Friends
description:
S01 E04 — The One With the Winner
In the Grand Finale, the final teams face off in their toughest challenges yet.

title: Hard Times: Lost on Long Island
description: Filmmaker Marc Levin examines how the weak economy and long-term unemployment impact the lives of four families.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E01 — Never the New
In 1882, Marian arrives at the home of her "old money" aunts Agnes and Ada, whose new neighbors vie to break into New York high society.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E02 — Money Isn't Everything
Marian receives a visit from Tom Raikes, whose legal advice Peggy seeks; the Russells take center stage at a charity bazaar.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E03 — Face the Music
An unfortunate development finds George's new rail station under threat; Marian continues to see Mr. Raikes despite Agnes' warnings.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E04 — A Long Ladder
In the aftermath of a tragedy, George agrees to help Bertha; a visit has a lasting impact on the staff of Russell house.

title: Allen v. Farrow
description:
S01 E01 — Episode 1
Mia Farrow recounts her relationship with Woody Allen, once a beloved father figure to her seven children; Dylan, their adopted daughter, speaks to the escalating discomfort she felt under the intensity of Woody's attention.

title: Allen v. Farrow
description:
S01 E02 — Episode 2
As Farrow and Allen ascend the ranks as a Hollywood power couple, their close-knit family is torn apart by Woody's relationship with Mia's daughter Soon-Yi; Dylan details the abuse allegations that changed her life.

title: Allen v. Farrow
description:
S01 E03 — Episode 3
Mia tries to shield Dylan from the trauma of repeated questioning; Allen's legal and PR teams say that Mia is a scorned woman and unfit mother who brainwashed her children; two separate 1992 investigations in New York and Connecticut are reexamined.

title: Allen v. Farrow
description:
S01 E04 — Episode 4
Dylan and the family attempt to heal after a bitter 1993 custody battle; the momentum of the #MeToo movement, with Ronan Farrow's public support, emboldens Dylan to go public with her story for the first time.

title: Paseo
description: A woman becomes displaced and alienated by her surroundings while traveling through Spain. She begins to lose control of her emotional and psychological self as she explores another possible life.

title: A Zest for Death: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
description: Hannah Swensen is determined to get to the bottom of the mystery after her mother finds the dead body of a homeowner, and frequent patron of The Cookie Jar, while house-hunting for her sister Michelle.

title: We Met in December
description: After a magical night sharing hopes, dreams and a perfect kiss, strangers Annie and Dave lose each other with no way to connect. They embark on a quest to find each other by Christmas.

title: Crossword Mysteries
description:
S01 E03 — Abracadaver
During Tess' birthday celebration, the headlining magician at the Magic Manor winds up dead, and Tess and Logan find themselves swept up in a world where things aren't always what they appear to be.

title: Crossword Mysteries
description:
S01 E04 — Terminal Descent
When Tess prepares for a crossword challenge against a supercomputer, the engineer behind it gets murdered, spurring her and Logan to seek answers before they become the next victims.

title: A Zest for Death: A Hannah Swensen Mystery

title: Selena + Chef
description:
S01 E08 — Selena + Tanya Holland
Bay Area legend Tanya Holland connects Selena to her Southern roots with a soul food feast; buttermilk fried chicken and fresh-baked cheddar scallion biscuits are on the menu.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E01 — Platform 9 3/4
The nine baking pairs create a piece that shows their love for Harry Potter.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E02 — Gringotts Wizarding Bank
The teams are in Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create 3-foot showpieces inspired by the bank's main hall, tunnels and vaults.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E03 — Diagon Alley
In a salute to the famed shops of Diagon Alley, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the bakers to make 50 handheld desserts to feed a crowd of Harry Potter fans, who vote on a winner; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team must go.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E04 — The Forbidden Forest
James and Oliver Phelps host as pairs of professional bakers create edible showpieces on the actual Harry Potter film sets; guest actors from the films share behind the scenes experiences as they join judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Pee-wee as Himself
description:
S01 E01
In the 1980s, Paul Reubens becomes a global sensation with his alter-ego Pee-wee Herman, but fame proves to be a complicated companion.

title: Pee-wee as Himself
description:
S01 E02
After taking Pee-wee to television, Reubens endures a series of scandals before reemerging as a cult figure and reclaiming his legacy.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E04
Following new recruit John Stewart and "Lantern" legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

title: Superman
description: Tech billionaire Lex Luthor seizes the opportunity to get the Man of Steel out of the way for good. Will intrepid reporter Lois Lane and Superman's four-legged companion, Krypto, be able to help him before it's too late?

While Ryan works up the courage to tell his passengers the truth, Karen comes out of hiding.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E02 — What an Unseasonal Delight
With the ship facing a fiery threat, Billie hatches a plan that could save some passengers; Iris makes a risky bid on Earth; Ryan finds himself in the middle of a three-way couples' quarrel; Mia shares some shocking news with Doug.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E03 — Is It a Good Dot?
After crossing paths with an unclassified research station, the crew discover that their new friends may not be what they say they are.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E04 — How It Ends: As a Starter and a Main
Iris and Judd attempt to blackmail mission control, while the presence of an unsavory stowaway leads to a ship-wide lockdown.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E05 — Let's Play With Matches
After a failed revolt, the passengers put the ship's leadership to a vote, bringing forth a pack of unlikely candidates; on Earth, the office of the other President proposes a plan that could spell doom for Avenue 5.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E06 — Intoxicating Clarity
As the passengers get used to life under their new supreme leader, a discovery might be their ticket home.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E07 — I Love Judging People
As a TOTOPOTUS missile careens towards the ship, Ryan turns to an AI ranking system to decide the passenger's fate.

title: Avenue 5
description:
S02 E08 — That's Why They Call It A Missile
With the ship divided, both sides must fight to survive - while dooming the other half of Avenue 5 to imminent death.

title: Thunder Bay
description:
S01 E01 — Murder Capital #1
Ryan delves into the unexplained death of a young hockey player, Jordan Wabasse, from Webequie First Nation; he follows the criminal trial of Brayden Bushby, accused of murdering Indigenous woman, Barbara Kentner, with a trailer hitch.

description:

Yasmin struggles to engage Henry's drive, but an unexpected visitor forces him to make a choice; Harper has a revelation about both an old and a new friend.

Convinced that Kevin's destiny requires him to be in Miracle for the seventh anniversary of the Departure, Matt Jamison heads to Australia in an effort to bring Kevin home.

The puppet show is over.

Starting at the beginning.

Beauty in individuals; the fight for survival.

description: Advisers convince Lyndon B. Johnson (Michael Gambon) to commit U.S. soldiers and money to Vietnam in 1965.

description:
S01 E01 — Site Unseen
Archaeologist Emma Fielding unearths evidence of a 17th-century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, but the dead body that accompanies it embroils Emma and her students in a different kind of investigation.

title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
description:
S01 E02 — Past Malice
Emma is hired to consult on the acquisition of a castle-like estate that local legends claim carries a curse.
